zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code, h.zone_name as areaname, sum(b) as b, sum(a) as a, sum(hba1c_q1) as a1, sum(hba1c_q2) as a2, sum(hba1c_q3) as a3, sum(hba1c_q4) as a4 FROM {{S_TABLE}} as s join chospital_regis as h on s.hospcode = h.hoscode left join ccmihosp on ccmihosp.hcode = h.hoscode and ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} where s.b_year = {{YEAR}} and {{ZONE_CODE}} in (h.zone_code, 'ALL') and {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} in (h.dep, 'ALL') and {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} in (ccmihosp.splevel, 'ALL') and {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} in (h.tmb_code, 'ALL') and {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} in (h.amp_code, 'ALL') and {{PROVINCE_CODE}} in (h.chw_code, 'ALL') AND ( h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) ) group by h.zone_code, h.zone_name order by h.zone_code

province.label: จังหวัด
province.query: SELECT h.chw_name as areaname, sum(b) as b, sum(a) as a, sum(hba1c_q1) as a1, sum(hba1c_q2) as a2, sum(hba1c_q3) as a3, sum(hba1c_q4) as a4 FROM {{S_TABLE}} as s join chospital_regis as h on s.hospcode = h.hoscode left join ccmihosp on ccmihosp.hcode = h.hoscode and ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} where s.b_year = {{YEAR}} and {{ZONE_CODE}} in (h.zone_code, 'ALL') and {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} in (h.dep, 'ALL') and {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} in (ccmihosp.splevel, 'ALL') and {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} in (h.tmb_code, 'ALL') and {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} in (h.amp_code, 'ALL') and {{PROVINCE_CODE}} in (h.chw_code, 'ALL') AND ( h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) ) group by h.chw_name

hospital.label: โรงพยาบาล
hospital.query: SELECT h.hoscode, h.hosname as areaname, sum(b) as b, sum(a) as a, sum(hba1c_q1) as a1, sum(hba1c_q2) as a2, sum(hba1c_q3) as a3, sum(hba1c_q4) as a4 FROM chospital_regis as h left join {{S_TABLE}} as s on s.hospcode = h.hoscode and s.b_year = {{YEAR}} left join ccmihosp on ccmihosp.hcode = h.hoscode and ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} where h.hdc_regist =1 and {{ZONE_CODE}} in (h.zone_code, 'ALL') and {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} in (h.dep, 'ALL') and {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} in (ccmihosp.splevel, 'ALL') and {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} in (h.tmb_code, 'ALL') and {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} in (h.amp_code, 'ALL') and {{PROVINCE_CODE}} in (h.chw_code, 'ALL') AND ( h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) ) and h.hostype IN ('05', '06', '07', '11', '12', '15') group by h.hoscode, h.hosname

provider.label: หน่วยบริการ
provider.query: SELECT h.hoscode, h.hosname as areaname, sum(b) as b, sum(a) as a, sum(hba1c_q1) as a1, sum(hba1c_q2) as a2, sum(hba1c_q3) as a3, sum(hba1c_q4) as a4 FROM chospital_regis as h left join {{S_TABLE}} as s on s.hospcode = h.hoscode and s.b_year = {{YEAR}} left join ccmihosp on ccmihosp.hcode = h.hoscode and ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} where h.hdc_regist=1 and {{ZONE_CODE}} in (h.zone_code, 'ALL') and {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} in (h.dep, 'ALL') and {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} in (ccmihosp.splevel, 'ALL') and {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} in (h.tmb_code, 'ALL') and {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} in (h.amp_code, 'ALL') and {{PROVINCE_CODE}} in (h.chw_code, 'ALL') AND ( h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) ) group by h.hoscode, h.hosname

cup.label: เครือข่ายบริการ
cup.query: SELECT concat('CUP:', m.hmainname) as areaname, sum(b) as b, sum(a) as a, sum(hba1c_q1) as a1, sum(hba1c_q2) as a2, sum(hba1c_q3) as a3, sum(hba1c_q4) as a4 FROM {{S_TABLE}} as s join chospital_regis as h on s.hospcode = h.hoscode left join ccmihosp on ccmihosp.hcode = h.hoscode and ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} JOIN cmastercup as m ON s.hospcode = m.hsub where s.b_year = {{YEAR}} and {{ZONE_CODE}} in (h.zone_code, 'ALL') and {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} in (h.dep, 'ALL') and {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} in (ccmihosp.splevel, 'ALL') and {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} in (h.tmb_code, 'ALL') and {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} in (h.amp_code, 'ALL') and {{PROVINCE_CODE}} in (h.chw_code, 'ALL') AND ( h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) ) GROUP BY m.hmain, m.hmainname ORDER BY m.hmain
